review_locator: PMCID:PMC4074809, STAT3 Target Genes Relevant to Human Cancers; PMCID:PMC3838198, The IL-10/STAT3-mediated anti-inflammatory response: recent developments and future challenges
primary_title: Interleukin-10-induced neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin production in macrophages with consequences for tumor growth
decision_basis: Promote exact IL10-to-LCN2 gene bridge because primary human macrophage assays show IL-10/JAK/STAT3/C/EBPbeta-dependent LCN2 promoter activation, transcript induction and secreted NGAL output.

primary_title: Molecular mechanisms of IL-33-mediated stromal interactions in cancer metastasis
decision_basis: Promote exact IL33-to-MMP9 gene bridge because ST2 blockade, NF-kappaB inhibition and promoter/output assays support IL-33-dependent MMP9 transcription in macrophage systems.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7663688, Transcriptional Regulation of Inflammasomes; PMCID:PMC6387150, Interleukin-18 in Health and Disease
primary_title: Roles of IFN Consensus Sequence Binding Protein and PU.1 in Regulating IL-18 Gene Expression
decision_basis: Promote exact IRF8-to-IL18 gene bridge because the cited murine macrophage primary shows LPS-responsive Il18 promoter control through an IRF8/ICSBP binding element with factor-specific EMSA and mutagenesis evidence.
limitations_preserved: Murine macrophage promoter context; preserve distinct IRF8/PU.1 promoter regions and distinguish Il18 transcript from pro-IL-18 processing and mature secretion; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4074809, STAT3 Target Genes Relevant to Human Cancers; PMCID:PMC3838198, The IL-10/STAT3-mediated anti-inflammatory response: recent developments and future challenges
primary_title: Interleukin-10-induced neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin production in macrophages with consequences for tumor growth
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-10/STAT3 regulation of NGAL/LCN2; the cited primary demonstrates IL-10-induced LCN2/NGAL promoter activity, STAT3 and C/EBPbeta occupancy, and transcript/protein induction in primary human macrophages.
limitations_preserved: Human primary macrophage model; promoter, ChIP and inhibitor evidence supports an IL-10→JAK/STAT3/C/EBPbeta→LCN2 transcriptional bridge, while secreted NGAL protein is a measured output in this model; distinguish LCN2 transcript from protein and downstream LCN2 receptor/ligand biology; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC11927177, Cancer-associated fibroblasts: a pivotal regulator of tumor microenvironment in the context of radiotherapy; PMCID:PMC6237443, Molecular mechanisms of IL-33-mediated stromal interactions in cancer metastasis
primary_title: Molecular mechanisms of IL-33-mediated stromal interactions in cancer metastasis
decision_basis: The review identifies the IL-33-ST2-NF-kappaB-MMP9 axis in tumor-associated macrophages; the cited primary shows ST2-dependent MMP9 induction, NF-kappaB inhibition sensitivity, promoter activity and macrophage MMP9 output.
limitations_preserved: Tumor-associated macrophage and pancreatic-cancer context; ST2 blockade, NF-kappaB inhibition and promoter/output assays support IL-33-dependent MMP9 transcription, but MMP9 mRNA, secreted enzyme activity and tumor effects are distinct layers; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7663688, Transcriptional Regulation of Inflammasomes; PMCID:PMC6387150, Interleukin-18 in Health and Disease
primary_title: Roles of IFN Consensus Sequence Binding Protein and PU.1 in Regulating IL-18 Gene Expression
decision_basis: The reviews identify an ICSBP/IRF8 element in the murine Il18 promoter; the cited primary shows LPS-responsive promoter activity, IRF8-site dependence, EMSA/supershift evidence and increased expression after ICSBP expression in RAW264.7 macrophages.
limitations_preserved: Murine macrophage promoter context; IRF8/ICSBP and PU.1 regulate distinct Il18 promoter regions, so preserve cofactor/promoter architecture and distinguish Il18 transcript from pro-IL-18 processing and mature secretion; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
